<a name="Generate"></a>
## func [Generate](<https://github.com/brii26/release-signer/blob/main/pkg/keys/keys.go#L24>)

```go
func Generate(p profile.Profile) (crypto.Signer, error)
```

Generate creates a key pair for profile p using crypto/rand: RSA 3072 bit \(e = 65537\), ECDSA P\-256, or Ed25519. It returns an error for an unknown profile.

<a name="KeyID"></a>
## func [KeyID](<https://github.com/brii26/release-signer/blob/main/pkg/keys/keys.go#L152>)

```go
func KeyID(pub crypto.PublicKey) (string, error)
```

KeyID returns hex\_lower\(SHA\-256\(DER SPKI\)\) of pub. The DER is re\-exported from the key, so PEM line endings and line wrapping never change the result.

<details><summary>Example</summary>
<p>

The keyid is the lowercase hex SHA\-256 of the DER SPKI, so it is always 64 characters.

```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/brii26/release-signer/pkg/keys"
	"github.com/brii26/release-signer/pkg/profile"
)

func main() {
	signer, err := keys.Generate(profile.ECDSA)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	id, err := keys.KeyID(signer.Public())
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(len(id))
}
```

#### Output

```
64
```

</p>
</details>

<a name="ParsePrivatePEM"></a>
## func [ParsePrivatePEM](<https://github.com/brii26/release-signer/blob/main/pkg/keys/keys.go#L66>)

```go
func ParsePrivatePEM(data []byte) (crypto.Signer, profile.Profile, error)
```

ParsePrivatePEM parses a PKCS\#8 "PRIVATE KEY" PEM and returns the signer and its profile. Keys whose type or parameters do not match a supported profile are rejected.

<details><summary>Example</summary>
<p>

Generate a key pair, export the private key as PKCS\#8 PEM, and read it back.

```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/brii26/release-signer/pkg/keys"
	"github.com/brii26/release-signer/pkg/profile"
)

func main() {
	signer, err := keys.Generate(profile.Ed25519)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	pemBytes, err := keys.MarshalPrivatePEM(signer)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	_, prof, err := keys.ParsePrivatePEM(pemBytes)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(prof)
}
```

#### Output

```
ed25519
```

</p>
</details>

## func [ParsePublicPEM](<https://github.com/brii26/release-signer/blob/main/pkg/keys/keys.go#L89>)

```go
func ParsePublicPEM(data []byte) (crypto.PublicKey, profile.Profile, error)
```

ParsePublicPEM parses an SPKI "PUBLIC KEY" PEM and returns the key and its profile. Keys whose type or parameters do not match a supported profile are rejected.

<a name="ProfileOf"></a>
## func [ProfileOf](<https://github.com/brii26/release-signer/blob/main/pkg/keys/keys.go#L122>)

```go
func ProfileOf(pub crypto.PublicKey) (profile.Profile, error)
```

ProfileOf returns the profile of pub after checking its parameters: RSA must be 3072 bit with e = 65537, ECDSA must use P\-256, and Ed25519 is accepted as is.

<a name="WriteKeyPair"></a>
## func [WriteKeyPair](<https://github.com/brii26/release-signer/blob/main/pkg/keys/keys.go#L169>)

```go
func WriteKeyPair(prefix string, k crypto.Signer, force bool) (privPath, pubPath string, err error)
```

WriteKeyPair writes \<prefix\>.key.pem \(mode 0600\) and \<prefix\>.pub.pem \(mode 0644\) and returns both paths. Existing files are only overwritten when force is true.
